(II)--(Ananta): a तामस form of विष्णु down below the पाताल regions; with १००० jewelled heads, purple garment, white necklace; in his hands are the plough and mace; worshipped by लक्ष्मी and वारुणी; when the deluge sets in, he vomits venomed fire devouring the three worlds; नाग maids adorn him with fragrant sandal paste; celestials and Asuras worship him; गन्गा worshipped him and learnt from him astronomy and astrology; supports the whole earth with his head;
1: Vi. II. 5. १३-27.
the best of नागस्;
2: Ib. III. 2. ५१.
is बलराम.
3: Ib. V. २५. 1; ३५. 3.
[page३-462+ २९]
